annotationRationale: The common-multiple bound forces a nontrivial gcd. Factoring 323 then bounds the divisor gap, and an explicit number attains that bound.
sourceMethod: Followed the official shared-gcd argument and the construction n=6460, making explicit why the construction has no intervening divisor.

review.mathCheck: A divisor \(d>323\) coprime to 323 would force \(n\ge323d>10000\). Otherwise \(g=\gcd(d,323)\ge17\) and \(g\mid(d-323)\), so \(d\ge340\). The even four-digit number 6460 has divisors 323 and 340; the bound excludes every intervening divisor. Thus choice C is correct.
